text:
Anya: Quick sync — planning a staged rollout for Dedicated Reserved Pools with three pilot customers. Goal: validate burst/soft-allowance semantics, preemption rules, autoscale behavior, and billing integration. Proposal: 3-week pilot each, soft-burst bucket per tenant (configurable), strict preempt after headroom < 5%. Thoughts?
Mike: Quick Q — do we already capture tenant-level short-window occupancy and preempt events in a way we can use for postmortem and SLAs?
Liam: We have occupancy and KV cache metrics per pool, but not an event stream for preempt decisions. We can emit preempt events to the telemetry pipeline in 2 sprints.
Sylvia: Rollout gating idea: canary at 5% traffic for 48h, then 25% for 72h, then full. Gate if p95 latency increases > 20% or error rate > 0.5% above baseline. Also require that 99th percentile of preempted requests (latency-impacting ops) is below 500ms.
Dalia: From pilots: customers want a clear SLA on burst availability and an opt-in for "guaranteed sessions" (no preempt) for a premium. They also want clarity on how burst charges are reported.
Anya: For billing I propose two options to offer per-customer during pilot: (A) prepaid burst credits consumed when soft-burst exceeded, (B) pay-as-you-go overage at a higher per-unit rate. Pilot customers can pick. Need ops to wire billing export for both.
Mike: For autoscale policy we should avoid aggressive scale-ups that spike infra cost. Proposal: occupancy bands + predictive buffer. Example config: target_util = 0.70, min_headroom = 0.10, burst_allowance = 2x baseline for short windows (60s). Predictive scaler uses 5m trend to add capacity early.
Liam: Implementation notes: predictive scaler requires sequence-length-aware kernels to avoid perf cliffs. We'll add a conservative fallback to model-variant routing if scale-up isn't fast enough. Also need an API to pin model variants per tenant.
Sylvia: Observability checklist: per-tenant metrics (util, queued, evicted_sessions), burst_credit_balance, preempt_event_count, model_variant_fallback_count, and a dashboard with burn-down for each pilot. Alerting: burn-rate > 3x expected for 10m -> page.
Dalia: Ops ask: include a short plain-language doc for pilots: what counts as "burst", how billing works, preemption behavior, and how to request guaranteed sessions. Customers need a contact and an SLA timeline for escalations.
Anya: Draft acceptance criteria (suggested):
```
- Functional: reserved pool allocates min guaranteed GPUs and respects tenant isolation
- Burst semantics: soft-burst is honored up to config; when exceeded we throttle/eject per policy, with clear preempt order
- Autoscale: predictive scaling triggers and falls back gracefully; no p95 latency regressions > 20% in pilot
- Observability: metrics and alerts listed by Sylvia are live
- Billing: burst usage exported to billing export and visible in console per-customer
- Docs/Onboarding: pilot runbook + customer-facing FAQ published
```
Mike: One subtlety — "preempt order" should be deterministic and observable. Suggest rule: 1) best-effort sessions, 2) non-committed low-priority streams, 3) avoid evicting pinned (committed) sessions unless catastrophic. Also emit a reason code for each eviction.
Liam: Agree. We'll add a reason code enum (BEST_EFFORT, LOW_PRIORITY, HYBRID_EVICT, EMERGENCY) and include it in telemetry.
Sylvia: Canary/rollback criteria proposal: if error_rate > 0.5% OR any client reports >2 minute degradation in availability for their committed sessions -> rollback immediate and notify customers. Also require warm start test across dev/stage before pilot.
Dalia: On communications: we'll send customers a one-pager and a kickoff call template. Also ask legal to sign off on the temporary pilot SLA language.

oncall-bot: Deployment successful: rollout/dedicated/pilot-config v0.3 -> prod-edge at 1764567908 :white_check_mark:
Mike: Action items I can take: add deterministic eviction order + reason codes, wire billing export hooks. ETA 2 weeks.
Liam: I'll add preempt-event emission and model-variant pin API. ETA 3 sprints.
Sylvia: I'll build the pilot dashboard and set the alerts. ETA 10 business days.
Dalia: I'll prepare customer-facing docs and coordinate kickoff calls. ETA 1 week.
Anya: Great — I'll consolidate this into a short PRD and schedule a sync with the pilot customers for next Tuesday. If no objections by EOD I'll lock the acceptance checklist and pilot cadence. :thumbsup:
